author: N6rL
content:
GrobidStructureEnricher implemented and tested.

Files:
- alcanzai-understanding/src/alcanzai_understanding/grobid_enricher.py (new, ~260 lines)
- alcanzai-understanding/pyproject.toml (added httpx>=0.27)
- tests/test_grobid_enricher.py (new, 39 unit tests)

Key decisions baked in:
- XPaths scoped to .//tei:teiHeader// for authors and year to prevent citation analytic blocks from contaminating paper metadata
- stdlib xml.etree.ElementTree (consistent with ArxivSource, no lxml dep)
- data keys: grobid_blocks, grobid_metadata, grobid_tei_xml (raw XML for CitationEnricher #27)
- All GROBID failures → EnrichmentResult.error; never raised
- ContentTypeMismatchError raised on wrong content type (programming error path)

Test count: 89 passed (was 50 before this issue). Rust: clean. ruff: clean. pyright: 0 errors.
Mutation testing: manual gate, M2 milestone-gated (ADR-006). Estimated mutants ~18.
